def compensated_cart(c,p,R,duration,opening,tag):
 """Compensate static servo tracking error using proprioception."""
 now=np.array(c.o.meta['proprio']['now']);q0=now[:7];qt=now[16:23]
 q=ik(np.array(p),R,q0)
 c.joint(q+(qt-q0),duration,opening,tag)
 return c.obs(tag+'_settled',seconds=1)

def carry(c,G,box_goal,fraction=1,duration=6,tag='carry'):
 from scipy.spatial.transform import Slerp
 now=np.array(c.o.meta['proprio']['now']);q0=now[:7];qt=now[16:23]
 start=fk(q0);end=box_goal@np.linalg.inv(G)
 rs=Slerp([0,1],Rot.from_matrix([start[:3,:3],end[:3,:3]]));q=q0.copy();actions=[]
 n=int(round(duration/.06))
 for v in np.linspace(0,1,n+1)[1:]:
  u=fraction*v*v*(3-2*v)
  p=(1-u)*start[:3,3]+u*end[:3,3]
  q=ik(p,rs([u]).as_matrix()[0],q)
  actions.append(np.r_[q+(qt-q0),0])
 o=c.r.submit('joint_position',actions,dt=.06,cameras=c.cams,video='both',include_depth=True,note=tag)
 o.save(str(RUN/tag));c.correct_cameras(o);c.o=o
 return c.obs(tag+'_settled',seconds=1)

def run_episode():
 """Execute the authored RGB-D grasp, transport and visual correction."""
 c=Controller();o=c.obs('start');box=estimate(o);Rbox=rz(box[3]);Rgrasp=Rbox@rx(np.pi)
 q=ik(np.r_[box[:2],.18],Rgrasp,np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'][:7]))
 c.joint(q,4,.04,'approach_above');c.obs('approach_settled',seconds=1)
 compensated_cart(c,np.r_[box[:2],.09],Rgrasp,2.5,.04,'descend_90mm')
 compensated_cart(c,np.r_[box[:2],.038],Rgrasp,2.5,.04,'grasp_height')
 c.joint(np.array(c.o.meta['proprio']['now'][16:23]),1.5,0,'close')
 o=c.obs('close_settled',seconds=1);Tclose=fk(o.meta['proprio']['now'][:7])
 G0=np.linalg.inv(Tclose)@tf(box[:3],Rbox)
 p=Tclose[:3,3].copy();p[2]+=.15
 o=compensated_cart(c,p,Tclose[:3,:3],3,0,'lift')
 T=fk(o.meta['proprio']['now'][:7]);B=T@G0
 p,R=estimate_pose(o,B[:3,3],B[:3,:3],'lift');G=np.linalg.inv(T)@tf(p,R)
 task=o.meta['task'];pt=np.array(task['target_pos']);w,x,y,z=task['target_quat_wxyz']
 Rt=Rot.from_quat([x,y,z,w]).as_matrix();goal=tf(pt,Rt)
 o=carry(c,G,goal,.5,4.8,'carry_half');T=fk(o.meta['proprio']['now'][:7]);B=T@G
 p,R=estimate_pose(o,B[:3,3],B[:3,:3],'half');G=np.linalg.inv(T)@tf(p,R)
 o=carry(c,G,goal,1,6,'carry_target')
 for i in range(2):
  T=fk(o.meta['proprio']['now'][:7]);B=T@G
  p,R=estimate_pose(o,B[:3,3],B[:3,:3],'feedback_'+str(i));G=np.linalg.inv(T)@tf(p,R)
  if np.linalg.norm(p-pt)<.008 and np.linalg.norm(Rot.from_matrix(Rt@R.T).as_rotvec())<np.deg2rad(8):break
  desired=goal@np.linalg.inv(G)
  o=compensated_cart(c,desired[:3,3],desired[:3,:3],2.5,0,'correct_'+str(i))
 o=c.obs('final_hold',seconds=10);T=fk(o.meta['proprio']['now'][:7]);B=T@G
 p,R=estimate_pose(o,B[:3,3],B[:3,:3],'final');draw_box(o,p,R,'final')
 np.savez(OUT/'final_grasp.npz',G=np.linalg.inv(T)@tf(p,R),p=p,R=R,pt=pt,Rt=Rt,q=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'][:7]),target=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'][16:23]))
 print('Final visual estimates:',np.linalg.norm(p-pt),'m',np.rad2deg(np.linalg.norm(Rot.from_matrix(Rt@R.T).as_rotvec())),'degrees')
